title: HybridEvalMetrics
description: Aggregate metrics for a hybrid (mixed synthetic + IAFDB) evaluation, written by egm-classifier's hybrid-eval CLI as hybrid_eval_metrics.json. Schema version 1.0. Pairs with the predictions file written under the predictions.schema.json contract; this metrics file records the aggregate scores while the predictions file holds per-trace outputs. Terminology note: 'hybrid' here follows the cardiac-ML convention established by Sánchez et al. 2021 (mixed in silico + in vivo data) — see project/known_issues.md for the rationale.

schema_version.description: Versioned schema identifier. Consumers MUST refuse unknown major versions.

predictions_schema_version.description: Version stamp for the sibling predictions CSV/JSON pair so CSV consumers can validate it (CSV has no place for an embedded version field). Producer MUST write the predictions file using this exact version.

created_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp captured at write time.

producer.description: Identifies the model + run that produced this eval. Matches the producer object in the paired predictions manifest.

run_id.description: Run identifier matching the corresponding run.json.

mixed.description: Aggregate metrics computed on the full mixed synthetic + IAFDB evaluation set (both sources combined).

n.description: Total rows in the eval set.

n_positives.description: Synthetic-fibrotic rows in the eval set (the positive class).

n_negatives.description: IAFDB-healthy rows in the eval set (the negative class).

metrics.description: Scalar metrics computed across the mixed set. Well-known keys: auroc, accuracy, precision, recall, f1, ece. Confusion-matrix counts may appear under a nested 'confusion' object with keys tp/fp/tn/fn. Producer-defined additional keys are allowed for forward extension.

iafdb_only.description: Metrics computed on the IAFDB rows alone — used to detect calibration saturation and shortcut behaviors that aggregate metrics on the mixed set can hide. A model that calls every IAFDB row 'fibrotic' will look fine on AUROC if the synthetic side separates well, but will show 1.0 FPR here.

mean_prob_fibrotic.description: Mean predicted P(fibrotic) across IAFDB rows. Healthy ground truth, so a well-calibrated model should produce a value well below 0.5. Values close to 1.0 indicate the model has saturated on the synthetic distribution.

fpr_at_0_5.description: False-positive rate at the 0.5 decision threshold (fraction of IAFDB rows predicted as fibrotic). 0.0 is ideal; 1.0 means the model rejects every real healthy trace.

p1_prob_fibrotic.description: 1st-percentile of predicted P(fibrotic) on IAFDB rows. Low values indicate the model HAS produced low probabilities for some real traces (the decision function isn't fully saturated). Values close to 1.0 are a saturation flag — no threshold will recover usable behavior.

per_patient.description: Optional per-patient breakdown keyed by patient_id (e.g. 'iaf1'..'iaf8'). Inner shape is producer-defined; convention is one object per patient with the same scalar metrics as the iafdb_only aggregate.
